Near Home.title: LNHS - Introduction to Fungi
Near Home.summary: Join the London Natural History Society (LNHS) for an introduction to fungi on Hampstead Heath lead by Mario Tortelli. Meeting at Hampstead Heath overground station. Bring lunch, toilets on the Heath. Due to high demand places may be limited. Email hampsteadbookings@lnhs.org.uk to register, with the name and date of the walk in the subject. Meet at 12pm at the Heath Info Hut (the former Tennis Bookings Hut), Hampstead Heath, near the Parliament Hill tennis courts - no need to book, although you can let us know that you’re planning to come along so that we know roughly how many to expect.
